title: Running tests for rust/feature-flags
answers: How do I run tests for rust/feature-flags?
What database setup is required before running cargo test on feature-flags?
Why are feature-flags integration tests failing with database connection errors?
body:
Integration tests in `rust/feature-flags/tests` require a local PostgreSQL test database initialized via Django:
1. Start Docker dependencies from root: `docker compose -f ../docker-compose.dev.yml up -d`.
2. Initialize the test database once: `TEST=1 python manage.py setup_test_environment --only-postgres`.
3. Run all crate tests: `cargo test --package feature-flags`.
4. Run an individual integration test suite: `cargo test --package feature-flags --test test_flags`.
Pure unit tests can run without Postgres: `cargo test --package feature-flags --lib`.
